name: Kantor AI - Finance & Billing Reminder Agent

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  b.kode_billing_layanan,
  b.nomor_internet,
  COALESCE(c.nama_pelanggan, 'Pelanggan') AS nama_pelanggan,
  COALESCE(c.nomor_hp, '') AS nomor_hp,
  b.periode_tagihan,
  CAST(b.total_layanan AS DECIMAL(15,2)) AS total_tagihan,
  b.status_bill_lay
FROM trx_billing_layanan b
LEFT JOIN view_batchjob c ON b.nomor_internet = c.nomor_internet
WHERE b.status_bill_lay = '13'
  AND CAST(b.total_layanan AS DECIMAL(15,2)) > 0
  AND (b.hide IS NULL OR b.hide = '0')
  AND (b.kode_bandwith NOT LIKE '%FREE%')
ORDER BY b.date_create DESC
LIMIT 50;
